mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medias ( post_id, media_type, media_url, sort_order, original_file_name, content_type, file_size, created_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{mediaType}, #{mediaUrl}, NVL( #{sortOrder, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ( SELECT NVL(MAX(sort_order) + 1, 0) FROM medias WHERE post_id = #{postId} ) ), #{originalFileName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
